wo-jpfa-JR4684.d:
PT Japfa Food Indonesia (Wonoayu, Sidoarjo)

Ringkasan Pekerjaan

Sanitation Operator bertanggung jawab untuk memastikan kebersihan dan sanitasi fasilitas produksi PT Japfa Food Indonesia sesuai dengan standar kebersihan dan keamanan pangan yang berlaku.

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan

* Melaksanakan prosedur sanitasi dan pembersihan mesin produksi, peralatan, dan area kerja sesuai dengan standar operasional prosedur (SOP) yang ditetapkan.
* Memastikan semua peralatan dan area kerja bebas dari kontaminasi silang.
* Menggunakan bahan kimia pembersih dan desinfektan dengan benar dan aman.
* Melakukan inspeksi rutin terhadap kebersihan fasilitas dan melaporkan temuan atau penyimpangan kepada atasan.
* Mencatat dan mendokumentasikan semua aktivitas sanitasi dan pembersihan yang dilakukan.
* Menjaga ketersediaan dan kebersihan alat-alat kebersihan yang digunakan.
* Melaksanakan tindakan perbaikan segera jika ditemukan masalah sanitasi.
* Mematuhi semua peraturan kesehatan, keselamatan, dan lingkungan kerja yang berlaku.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan

* Memahami prinsip-prinsip kebersihan dan sanitasi industri pangan. * Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.
* Teliti, disiplin, dan bertanggung jawab.
* Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift.
* Memiliki fisik yang sehat dan kuat

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

wo-jpfa-JR4730.d:
Supports day-to-day poultry health activities to ensure effective disease prevention, biosecurity, animal welfare, and flock performance. The role focuses on field support, routine monitoring, and documentation in line with established poultry health protocols.

Support implementation of poultry health programmes, including vaccination, biosecurity, and routine flock health checks.
Assist in monitoring flock health indicators, morbidity/mortality trends, and compliance with health protocols.
Support field execution of poultry health practices in coordination with operations and veterinary teams.
Assist in investigation and reporting of poultry health issues and disease incidents.
Ensure adherence to poultry health regulations, animal welfare standards, and biosecurity procedures.
Maintain poultry health records, logs, and routine reports.
Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance flock welfare and farm performance.
Follow established poultry health procedures, safety practices, and governance requirements.
